column1: # Sidecars that exceed a limit, are reported by check_pairing.py as a warning
# rather than a failure, and are NOT to be silently shortened. The copy is
# verbatim from the channel's source document, so shortening it here would put
# the sidecar and the source out of step and hide the defect.
# Columns: sidecar, measured size when listed, reason.
# The measured size is part of the contract. If the file grows past it the
# check fails again, so this list cannot quietly absorb a second overage.

column3: Pre-existing in product/COPY.md, not introduced here. COPY.md sets a self-imposed 300 character budget for a product description and prints this block's own length as 309, so the file states the budget and breaks it in the same document. Google publishes no character limit for this field, which COPY.md marks [UNVERIFIED], so nothing is known to be broken on the platform. Owner: whoever pastes the catalogue, either by shortening the block in COPY.md and regenerating, or by raising the budget with a first-party source for the real limit.
